Exercise: Kettlebell Dead Clean

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
pull

Difficulty Level:
intermediate

Movement Patterns:

- hinge
- pull

Primary Muscles:

- hamstrings

Secondary Muscles:

- calves
- glutes
- lower back
- quadriceps
- traps

Equipment:

- kettlebells

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
high

Recovery Time:
48 hours

Goals:

- improve_overall_strength_and_power
- strengthen_hamstrings_and_glutes

Contraindications:

- Lower back issues
- Shoulder injuries

Exercise Variations:

- name: Kettlebell Clean and Press, instructions: ['Clean the kettlebell to your shoulder.', 'Press the kettlebell overhead.']
- name: Single-Arm Kettlebell Dead Clean, equipment: single-arm kettlebells

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Barbell Deadlift, equipment: barbell
- exercise_name: Sumo Deadlift High Pull, equipment: barbell or kettlebells

Instructions:

- Place kettlebell between your feet. To get in the starting position, push your butt back and look straight ahead.
- Clean the kettlebell to your shoulder. Clean the kettlebell to your shoulders by extending through the legs and hips as you raise the kettlebell towards your shoulder. The wrist should rotate as you do so.
- Lower the kettlebell, keeping the hamstrings loaded by keeping your back straight and your butt out.
